subject: A trouble to display long labels on the top of the heatmap

messages.author: 25bbbc80fe76dcfe
messages.subject: A trouble to display long labels on the top of the heatmap
parts:
Dear Dr. Yu,

Many thanks for your efforts to develop this wonderful package!

I met a problem when I used gheatmap to make a plot. It is trouble to display some long labels on the top of the heatmap.

The script is attached below, and the two input data files are attached to this mail.

library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
tree <- read.tree("accessory_binary_genes.fa.newick")

genotype <- read.table("gene_presence_absence_ARGs.Rtab", sep="\t", header = T, stringsAsFactor=F)
genotype_matrix_t <- t(genotype)
colnames(genotype_matrix_t) <- genotype_matrix_t[1,]
genotype_matrix_t <- genotype_matrix_t[-1,]

p1 <- ggtree(tree) + geom_tiplab(align=TRUE, linesize=.5)
p1

p2 <- gheatmap(p1, genotype_matrix_t, offset = 0.3, width=1.1, font.size=3, 
               colnames=TRUE, colnames_angle=90, low = "white", high = "red", color = "black",
               colnames_position = "top", colnames_offset_y = -0.2,
               hjust=0) +
               scale_fill_manual(values=c("white", "red")) +
               theme(plot.margin = unit(c(2,1,2,1), "cm"))

p2


Any advice is very appreciated!


Best regards,

Zhuofei
